networks.name: factgate
networks.description: Check an agent website or x402 seller before you connect or pay: live answers, ERC-8004 identity on chain, vet402 delivery records. ALLOW, CAUTION or BLOCK with the reasons, plus AgentFacts.
sample_queries: Should my agent pay https://agent402.tools/api/weather-forecast? Give FactGate's verdict with the reasons.
Does https://agent-atlas-phi.vercel.app/agent_atlas answer as its manifest declares? Check its MCP server too.
Whose wallet is behind https://agent402.tools/api/weather-forecast? Compare its payTo with its ERC-8004 registration.
How does FactGate decide between ALLOW, CAUTION and BLOCK?

peer_policy.note: Local agents, page-local actions and the vet402.com MCP server only.

agent_mcp.reason: This is a static bundle; a public MCP facade requires an application host.
